cohort: The study included 127,694 singleton live births from the 2006 Canadian Birth-Census Cohort.
finding: Small-for-gestational-age birth was associated with both maternal education and income adequacy, while preterm birth was associated only with maternal education.
birth_weight: Small-for-gestational-age birth was defined as sex-specific birth weight below the 10th percentile for gestational age.
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as birth before 37 completed weeks of gestation.
